evidence.title: 🪄 Magic. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: 🪄 Magic.
summary: Essay on why folders of saved prompts fail, and why context files beat prompts when working with an AI chat.
description: A How to AI issue arguing the prompt is not the problem: 27 collected prompts still return generic text, so the author stopped writing prompts and writes files instead, and treats the tool as a chat rather than a one-shot prompt box.
